component.name: Herdr
component.summary: Terminals and coding agents that keep running

description.p: This is a community package of Herdr, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Herdr is a desktop window for terminals and coding agents. This package bundles herdr-core, which runs the terminals, so everything runs inside the Flatpak sandbox with no access to host commands. Terminals only see what the sandbox allows and may end when Herdr exits.
Usage telemetry is on by default, as upstream ships it. Turn it off in Settings, Privacy.
The file panel and git info read the folders your terminals are in, which needs access to your files. It is not granted by default; enable it with "flatpak override":
